items.title: Naomi Watts Flatters Her Feet in Gucci Horsebit Pumps at 'Road To The Golden Globes' Kick-Off Party in Toronto
items.summary: WWD footwear coverage of actress Naomi Watts wearing black Gucci Horsebit pumps with gilded hardware at a Golden Globes-season kickoff party in Toronto on Sept. 12, paired with a red draped top and tailored slacks. Descriptive celebrity-styling item, no independent evaluative verdict.

items.title: Dance Up-And-Comer of the Month BrokinPaper Made Music Inspired By Gesaffelstein -- Then Gucci Called
items.summary: Billboard profile of NYC producer BrokinPaper (Harrison Lee), naming him Dance Artist of the Month; piece notes Gucci recruited him to DJ its Cruise 2027 Times Square afterparty and a Gucci Berlin Gallery Weekend event, crediting the brand's cultural cachet in electronic music circles.

items.title: Gucci Eyewear's Fall 2026 Campaign Has the Look
items.summary: Fashion blog write-up of Gucci Eyewear's Fall/Winter 2026 campaign shot by Mark Seliger, describing Horsebit and Double G hardware details across new acetate and metal frame styles. Purely descriptive brand-promo coverage, no critical framing.

items.title: Kering Shares Jump as Gucci Stabilises and Second-Quarter Revenue Beats Forecasts
items.summary: Financial-press roundup noting Kering stock held broadly stable on Euronext as of Sept. 13, with investors watching whether Gucci's North America retail momentum (up roughly 7% in Q1, comparable sales decline narrowing in H1) can convert into sustained growth under CEO Luca de Meo's turnaround plan.

items.title: Gucci is struggling so it gambled $150million that F1 can 'make it cool again'
items.summary: Critical motorsport-press analysis framing Gucci's ~$150M Alpine F1 title sponsorship (Gucci Racing from 2027) as a high-stakes bet by a brand that has now posted eleven consecutive quarters of organic sales declines, arguing F1 needed Gucci's cachet less than Gucci needed F1's cultural relevance.
